sources.title: GitHub - ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed: Distributed Compiler and ...
sources.snippet: Triton-distributed is a distributed compiler designed for computation-communication overlapping, which is based on OpenAI Triton. Using Triton-distributed, programmers are able to develop efficient kernels comparable to highly-optimized libraries (including Distributed-GEMM and FLUX).

sources.title: Qwen3.5 GDN Prefill Kernel 优化 - 知乎
sources.snippet: 总结 本文介绍了 Qwen3-Next GDN prefill 阶段的部分 kernel 优化工作，性能提升较为可观。 GDN 算法原理和 Triton 侧的 kernel 实现来自 fla-org/flash-linear-attention，感谢参与以上工作的作者们。 如有相关问题或建议，欢迎留言，以及通过 GitHub Issue 或 PR 交流讨论。

sources.title: Welcome to Triton's documentation!
sources.snippet: Welcome to Triton's documentation! Triton is a language and compiler for parallel programming. It aims to provide a Python-based programming environment for productively writing custom DNN compute kernels capable of running at maximal throughput on modern GPU hardware.
